column1: # The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure). The NPDM declares 48 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on.

# nninitStartup asks SetHeapSize 0x18ce00000 (6.2 GB) with the 9 GB pool, as Mario Kart World. 256 MB in front + 4 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 8 GB heap region: a starting split, to be measured
# Float atomic adds whose old value is not used (the exposure and cubemap-to-SH reductions: 256 threads, or 96 groups of them, adding into 1-4 words through the translator's
# compare-and-swap loop) become a SIMD-group sum and one native float add (dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_redsum.py). 6 compute shaders, 23 loops; on an M5 1bba09ec4bc8ff67 361 -> 9 us,
# 6e28359aa3558f61 289 -> 70 us, 0.69 ms of the frame. DMSH_REDSUM=0 builds without it
# The game steps its time by a frame ratio, its base rate / its frame rate, whatever the frame took: frames longer than a vsync played in slow motion. The ratio takes the host's
# frame step instead (MATCH_FRAME_STEP in patches.py, found by its function on any build that keeps it): 1 vsync at 60 fps, 2 when 60 does not hold, so game time = real time
# Real speed at the game's own pacing (Frame rate = Game's own, DM_FPS_TARGET=0, the iPad's best): there the game's frame rate stays 60 whatever the frames take, so below 60 fps
# it ran in slow motion. The host measures the present interval (mean of 8, 1-4 vsyncs) and the frame-ratio stub (patches.py frame_step) divides by the matching whole fps in place
# of the game's 60; the pacing is untouched (nothing is held). DM_FPS_REAL=0 turns it off
# Late frames are not held longer (the launcher's Hold frames when late, DM_FPS_HOLD): with holding on, three late frames stepped to 30, the GPU clock then fell (a probe back
# to 60 measured the same work at 3.35x its GPU time on an M4 Pro) and the game stayed at 30 for minutes at a GPU time near 16.7 ms; off, a late frame is shown late and the
# game steps by the vsyncs that passed (M4 Pro, 1280x720: frame p50 17.3 ms, never 30). Under the iOS thermal cap the host still holds 30
# agl wraps its clears in render conditions on Donkey Kong Bananza and Splatoon Raiders; the same library here
